scientific_integrity: Proof is self-contained using Kronecker--Weyl, Rouche and elementary minimization. Standalone finite checks supplement but do not replace the infinite argument. Earlier geometric phase feasibility may imply some of the aperture formula, but no identified inspected source establishes the actual-zero modular distribution theorem.
scientific_limitations: Irrational three-term exponential sums only; all-but-countably-many periods and a single resonant period; no explicit best positive visiting-density constant; boundary residues need not be attained; historical publication priority is provisional.
title: Generic modular density and the sharp resonant phase aperture of an exponential trinomial
